title: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2025 — Tin
locator: Tin: World Mine Production and Reserves, 2024 estimates
notes: 2024 estimates from the original 2025 publication, not current-year production.
Shares use the sum of transcribed country estimates plus the reported Other countries category; no ISO2 is invented for Other countries.
HHI sums only identified country shares and is a lower bound because Other countries is unallocated.
Global production is geographic context, not evidence that this product sources from these countries.
